name: BookWhip Booking
author: fekbd

sections.description:
BookWhip Booking lets your customers book appointments on your website in four short steps: choose a service, choose a specialist (or “Any available”), pick a date and time, and enter their details. You manage everything from a clean admin screen inside WordPress.

It is made for salons, barbers, clinics, therapists, coaches, consultants, tutors, repair shops and any business that works by appointment.

Booking form

  • Step-by-step form: service → specialist → date & time → details → confirmation.
  • Only free times are shown. The server checks every booking again before saving it, and a per-staff lock makes double bookings impossible.
  • Works on desktop and mobile and uses your theme’s fonts.
  • Add it with the BookWhip Booking · Booking Form block or the [bwlite_booking] shortcode.
  • Start the form with one service or one specialist: [bwlite_booking service="2" staff="1"].
  • A “Book an Appointment” page is created for you on activation.
  • Simple rate limit per IP address to stop spam bookings.

Services

  • Name, description, optional category, duration, price (shown to customers), color.
  • Buffer time before and after each appointment.
  • Instant booking or “On approval” (you confirm each booking).
  • Active / inactive.

Staff

  • Name, email, phone, color and the services each person offers.
  • Weekly working hours with breaks.
  • Time off per person.

Days off

  • Holidays for the whole business or time off for one person.
  • Whole days or only some hours.

Bookings

  • List view with Upcoming / Past filters, status filter and search.
  • Week calendar view.
  • Booking detail with status: Pending, Confirmed, Completed, Cancelled, No-show.
  • “Add booking” for phone and walk-in bookings, checked against the same rules as online bookings.

Emails

  • Customer: booking received (on approval) or booking confirmed, with a calendar (.ics) file.
  • Customer: booking cancelled.
  • You: new booking.
  • Sent with WordPress’s own wp_mail(), so any SMTP plugin works.

Settings

  • Business name, notification email, currency code and symbol.
  • Time step, minimum notice and booking window.
  • Optional: delete all data when the plugin is deleted (off by default).

Privacy

  • No tracking, no external requests, no remote fonts or scripts.
  • Registers a personal data exporter and eraser for Tools → Export / Erase Personal Data.
  • Adds a suggested text to your privacy policy guide.

What is free

Everything on this page is free, with no limits on services, staff or bookings:

  • Booking form (block and shortcode) with only free times shown and no double bookings.
  • Unlimited services with duration, price, color, buffers and instant or on-approval booking.
  • Unlimited staff with weekly hours, breaks and time off.
  • Business-wide days off and holidays.
  • Bookings list, week calendar, booking detail and “Add booking” for phone and walk-in customers.
  • Email confirmations with a calendar (.ics) file, cancellation emails and new-booking alerts.
  • Privacy tools (export / erase personal data), no tracking.
  • Free updates and support in the WordPress.org forum.

BookWhip Pro

BookWhip Pro is a separate plugin, sold at bookwhip.app. It keeps everything above and adds:

Booking

  • Three booking form layouts (steps, one page, photo catalog) with your colors, font and logo.
  • Drag-and-drop team calendar, dashboard and reports.
  • Add-ons, several lengths per service, price per person, special prices.
  • Group classes, repeating visits, several services in one booking and a waiting list.
  • Locations and shared resources (rooms, chairs, equipment).
  • No-show rules and unfinished-booking reminders.

Money

  • Deposits or full payment with Stripe, PayPal, Square, Mollie, Razorpay, Paystack, Flutterwave, Mercado Pago, Authorize.net, WooCommerce or pay at the visit.
  • PDF invoices and receipts, refunds, coupons and several currencies.
  • Gift cards, memberships with included visits, and packages.
  • Quotes that turn into jobs and invoices.

Grow

  • Events with ticket types, QR e-tickets and check-in.
  • SMS and WhatsApp reminders and review requests.
  • Customer page to move, cancel and pay for bookings.
  • Staff app for phones with push notifications, commission and payroll.
  • Google Calendar and Outlook sync, Google Meet, Zoom and Teams links.
  • Elementor widgets, Spanish, French, German and Arabic translations, white label.
  • Spam protection with optional Cloudflare Turnstile.
  • Import from Bookly, Amelia and LatePoint.
  • Private support tickets.

Moving from free to Pro takes one click: Pro copies your services, staff hours, days off, customers and bookings, and your booking page keeps working.
sections.installation:
1. In your dashboard go to Plugins → Add New, search for “BookWhip Booking” and click Install, then Activate. Or upload the bookwhip-booking folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate it.
  2. The Welcome screen opens. Add your services under BookWhip Booking → Services.
  3. Add your staff under BookWhip Booking → Staff, choose their services and set their working hours.
  4. Check BookWhip Booking → Settings (business name, notification email, currency, booking rules).
  5. Visit the “Book an Appointment” page that was created for you, or add the block or shortcode to any page.
sections.faq:
How do I add the booking form to a page?

In the block editor, click + and search for “BookWhip”, then choose “Booking Form”. Or paste the shortcode [bwlite_booking] into any page. See BookWhip Booking → How to use for a shortcode builder.

Why does the form say “Online booking is not available yet”?

A service shows on the form only when it is active and at least one active staff member offers it. Open the staff member and tick the service under “Services”.

Why are no times shown on a day?

Check the staff member’s working hours for that weekday, days off, the minimum notice and the booking window under Settings. Times that are already booked (plus buffers) are hidden.

Can two customers book the same time?

No. Before saving, the plugin locks the staff member, checks the time again and only then saves the booking. The second customer is asked to pick another time.

Can customers pay online?

No. This plugin takes bookings only. The price is shown for information. Online payments and deposits are part of BookWhip Pro.

Which timezone is used?

Your site’s timezone (Settings → General). The form shows it next to the times.

Emails are not arriving.

The plugin uses wp_mail(). Many hosts need an SMTP plugin to deliver email reliably.

Is my data deleted when I delete the plugin?

Only if you turn on “Delete all plugin data when the plugin is deleted” under Settings. It is off by default.

Can I move to BookWhip Pro later?

Yes. BookWhip Pro (sold separately) adds online payments, gift cards, memberships, events and more. Its Data screen copies your services, staff hours, days off, customers and bookings from this plugin in one click, and your booking page keeps working. You can then turn this plugin off. Leave “Delete all plugin data” off until you have checked the copy.
